scenes.title: Open the app
scenes.voiceover: Need a quick GIF from a screen recording? Video to GIF Converter makes one right on your desktop. FFmpeg is built in, so there is nothing else to install.

scenes.title: Choose a video
scenes.voiceover: Click Choose video, then pick your clip. This one is a short screen recording.

scenes.title: Video info
scenes.voiceover: The app reads the video and shows its size, frame rate, and length.

scenes.title: Set options
scenes.voiceover: Set the frame rate to twelve, and the width to four hundred eighty pixels. Lower numbers mean a smaller file. Loop forever is already on.

scenes.title: Convert and save
scenes.voiceover: Click Convert and save, and choose where the GIF goes. A progress bar shows while it works. This short clip is done in about a second.

scenes.title: GIF preview
scenes.voiceover: When it finishes, the GIF plays right inside the app, and you can see how big the file is.
scenes.onscreen: The GIF plays in the app

scenes.title: Show in folder
scenes.voiceover: Show in folder takes you straight to the saved file.

scenes.title: Wrap up
scenes.voiceover: Pick a video, choose two numbers, and get a GIF. Everything stays on your computer.
